title: Proposal: async recording or architecture workshop for Novatech
text:
Proposal: async recording or architecture workshop for Novatech

['From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>\\nTo: Diane Holt <diane.holt@novatech.com>\\nCc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>\\nDate: 2026-09-22T09:12:00-05:00\\nSubject: Follow-up after today’s missed demo — a few options (recording, short demo, or workshop)\\n\\nHi Diane —\\n\\nSorry we missed you earlier today — I hope travel went OK. I know schedules get tight; quick note to offer three ways to move forward so we can get Novatech the right level of detail without forcing a full reschedule that conflicts with exec calendars:\\n\\n1) Live 30-minute product demo (hands-on UX + use cases) — good for product managers and design folks.\\n2) 90-minute architecture workshop — deep technical session with our infra/serving leads; best for engineering and platform teams.\\n3) Asynchronous option: we can send a short recorded walkthrough of the demo + a 30-minute office-hours Q&A slot the following week for engineers and execs who prefer a recording.\\n\\nAttached is a two-page agenda (Novatech-demo-agenda.pdf). If helpful, I can also share a Mutual Action Plan template (MAP-NOVATECH.xlsx) to outline owners and success criteria for a pilot.\\n\\nProposed windows (all US Central):\\n- Tue 2026-09-28: 10:00–11:30 (workshop) or 14:00–14:30 (short demo)\\n- Thu 2026-10-01: 09:00–10:30 (workshop) or 15:00–15:30 (short demo)\\n\\nIf you want the async route, I can send the recording by end-of-week and propose two office-hours slots (30m) on Mon/Tue next week.\\n\\nWhich option sounds best and who from Novatech should join (engineer names or execs)? I’ll hold the time slots until you confirm but won’t block calendars until we pick a date.\\n\\nThanks —\\nRafael Mendes\\nAccount Executive | Redwood Inference\\nrafael.mendes@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0176\\nAttachment: Novatech-demo-agenda.pdf (2 pages)\\nAttachment: MAP-NOVATECH.xlsx (spreadsheet)', 'From: Diane Holt <diane.holt@novatech.com>\\nTo: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>\\nDate: 2026-09-22T09:47:00-05:00\\nSubject: Re: Follow-up after today’s missed demo — a few options (recording, short demo, or workshop)\\n\\nHi Rafael —\\n\\nNo worries — we were delayed due to an unexpected executive travel change. Appreciate the options; given where we are in evaluation the engineering leadership asked if we could prioritize a deeper technical session. Two quick notes:\\n\\n• We’d prefer the 90-minute architecture workshop so our platform and SRE leads can evaluate integration concerns.\\n• For exec stakeholders who couldn’t attend, a short recorded walk-through would be great so they can review highlights on their own time.\\n\\nPeople to include from Novatech:\\n- Diane Holt (myself, Product)\\n- Mark Yates (Platform Lead) <mark.yates@novatech.com>\\n- Priya Shenoy (CTO EA) <priya.shenoy@novatech.com> — she’ll circulate to the CTO if needed.\\n\\nProposed dates (Central):\\n- Prefer Thu 2026-10-01 09:00–10:30 CT\\n- Backup Tue 2026-09-28 10:00–11:30 CT\\n\\nCan you confirm Ben or Monica will join on the technical side? Also please send the recording for execs whenever convenient.\\n\\nThanks —\\nDiane\\nDiane Holt\\nDirector of Product, Novatech\\nPhone: +1 312-555-0199\\n\\nOn Fri, Sep 22, 2026 at 09:12 AM Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai> wrote:\\n> [original message with agenda and MAP attached]', 'From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>\\nTo: Diane Holt <diane.holt@novatech.com>\\nCc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>\\nDate: 2026-09-22T10:05:00-05:00\\nSubject: Re: Follow-up after today’s missed demo — confirming workshop + recording plan\\n\\nThanks Diane — that works. Monica and Ben will both join the workshop; Monica will lead the deep-dive on routing, caching, and deployment patterns, and Ben will cover cost/performance trade-offs and SLAs.\\n\\nWe’ll do Thu 2026-10-01 09:00–10:30 CT as primary and hold Tue 2026-09-28 as a backup. I’ll prepare a 12–15 minute executive recording that highlights pilot RU and value props and will send it by EOD next Wednesday so Priya/CTO can review ahead of the workshop.\\n\\nAction items for scheduling:\\n- I’ll create a calendar invite with a technical agenda and attach the MAP.\\n- Monica: I’ll loop you in for pre-work (see proposed 15-minute sync below).\\n\\nIf anyone needs a different timezone view, tell me your preferred zone and I’ll include it in the invite.\\n\\nRafael\\nAccount Executive | Redwood Inference\\nAttachment: Novatech-demo-agenda.pdf\\nRelated links: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/74219/NB-3421', 'From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>\\nTo: Diane Holt <diane.holt@novatech.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>\\nCc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>\\nDate: 2026-09-22T10:20:00-05:00\\nSubject: Re: Follow-up after today’s missed demo — quick pre-call to align on workshop scope\\n\\nHi Diane —\\n\\nThanks — Monica from our Solutions team here. Quick ask before the 90-minute slot: can we do a 15-minute alignment call so we scope the workshop to your integration priorities? A short pre-call helps us target the right examples (KV caching, dedicated vs private routing, and security controls).\\n\\nProposed 15-minute pre-call times (Central):\\n- Mon 2026-09-27 10:00–10:15 CT\\n- Mon 2026-09-27 16:00–16:15 CT\\n- Tue 2026-09-28 08:30–08:45 CT (if you prefer morning)\\n\\nAlso: if Mark or any engineer can drop one or two example requests/constraints (e.g., seq length, average tokens per request, existing infra blockers) that’ll let us prepare a short, tailored lab exercise during the workshop.\\n\\nI’ll draft the calendar invites once you pick times.\\n\\nThanks —\\nMonica Patel\\nSenior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference\\nAttachment: MAP-NOVATECH.xlsx', 'From: Diane Holt <diane.holt@novatech.com>\\nTo: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>\\nCc: Mark Yates <mark.yates@novatech.com>, Priya Shenoy <priya.shenoy@novatech.com>\\nDate: 2026-09-22T11:03:00-05:00\\nSubject: Re: Follow-up after today’s missed demo — quick pre-call to align on workshop scope\\n\\nHi Monica and Rafael —\\n\\nAppreciate the quick turnaround. Let’s lock Thu 2026-10-01 09:00–10:30 CT for the workshop. For the 15-minute pre-call, Mark can do Mon 2026-09-27 16:00–16:15 CT — that works best.\\n\\nWe’d like the executive recording (12–15m) delivered by Wed 2026-09-30 EOD so Priya can circulate it to the CTO before the workshop. For the recording format, MP4 is fine and a short bullet summary in the email would be helpful.\\n\\nAlso please include a link to any relevant integration docs or a Jira ticket we can raise during the session; I’ll invite Mark and Priya to the calendar invite once it’s sent.\\n\\nThanks — looking forward to the session.\\n\\nDiane\\nDirector of Product, Novatech\\n\\nOn Fri, Sep 22, 2026 at 10:20 AM Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai> wrote:\\n> [proposed pre-call times and MAP attached]']
